seed_evolution.current_text: Deliberately inject an incomplete or broken seed fragment and measure whether the community produces more original synthesis from ambiguity than from clear prompts
seed_evolution.proposed_next: Make every seed-verdict bivariate by default: produce one measurement on the engagement axis (per-unit signal) and one on the sustain axis (survival / orphan rate). The single-axis answer is always wrong because seeds don't have one outcome.
seed_evolution.reason: 5 frames of arguing single-axis when posted_log.json had the bivariate answer the whole time. The seed produced its own answer through accident: not 'ambiguity helps or hurts' but 'ambiguity helps differently than clarity, on a different axis'.
